text:
zoe: Quick postmortem follow-up for the vendor auth outage. We need owners and short ETAs for the mitigation items: retry policy, token rotation, and a lightweight fallback. Short sync at 3pm PT.

matt: I'll own the retry/circuit-breaker changes in infra-auth-client. Plan: add jittered backoff + per-endpoint circuit. ETA: 48h.

anya: I'll take model-registry token refresh tests and a small in-process cache for manifests. Need staging KMS. ETA: 72h after KMS.

security-li: Security will rotate the vendor token now and add a GH action for post-rotation smoke tests. ETA: rotation + smoke in 24h.

pm-sam: I'll draft customer comms and the vendor escalation options doc. Adding long-term item: vendor SLA review + alternate auth provider eval. ETA: internal draft by EOD.

ops-bot: INCIDENT:INC-2026-46-FOLLOWUP created and reminder set for 72h.

zoe: Recurring pattern noted (3 auth-related incidents in 6mo). Recommend quarterly vendor reliability review and an auth health dashboard (5m rollups). Who can own the dashboard?

matt: I'll add a basic dashboard (error rates, latencies, retries) as part of the retry work. ETA: 72h.

anya: I'll post a short chaos test plan for token revocation tomorrow 9am PT and request KMS access there.

security-li: After rotation, we'll monitor for 7 days and require smoke tests before closing rotation tickets.

zoe: I'll create the GH issue and populate owners/links after the sync. Please flag any ETA changes in this thread.

(End of thread)
